title: Human-approved procurement evidence reconciliation and bilingual PR checks
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's explicit approval of the approximately two-hour priority plan on 2026-08-31: deepen public Nagoya Furo NEXT/Furo-ni and Tsukuba unified-memory/Sirius procurement evidence; reconcile linked inventory, catalog and roadmap records; validate Japanese/English equivalence and regressions; improve English-first/Japanese-second PR descriptions if time permits. This records the user's requested publication scope, not an independent review of the resulting research. Preserve historical evidence and open Coverage Gaps. All research remains single-agent, single-model, provisional and Consensus-incomplete. Do not enable unattended research, obtain restricted specifications, set procurement quantities or prices without evidence, or merge the review PR.
